name: TV/Commercial Display Production Line Solution
summary: A full-line automation solution for TV and commercial display manufacturers, covering the entire process from assembly to packaging.
contentHtml:
The TV/Commercial Display Production Line Solution is a turnkey project solution provided by TXAM for display manufacturers.

Solution Components

The full line covers dispensing, bracket placement, lamination, flip inspection, final packaging, and other processes, achieving fully automated production from raw materials to finished products.

Solution Advantages

  • One-key compatibility with multiple sizes from 65 to 110 inches
  • Full-process robot automation
  • CAD import for one-key changeover, short debugging time
  • High full-line yield and consistent product quality
  • True turnkey project implementation

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and debugging to after-sales service.
